2026_01_BAL_IND.headline: Baltimore’s missing interior defenders give Indianapolis a path to challenge the middle
2026_01_BAL_IND.paragraph1: Baltimore will open without Nnamdi Madubuike and Teddye Buchanan, while Indianapolis enters with only Austin Ajiake carrying a game designation. That gives the Colts a reason to probe the Ravens between the tackles and make Baltimore’s reshaped front hold up for full drives. The Ravens can flip the pressure back with Lamar Jackson’s movement and option stress, forcing Indianapolis to defend the quarterback, the run game and layered throws without losing structure.
2026_01_BAL_IND.model_rationale: Baltimore’s offensive multiplicity can create assignment conflicts, but Indianapolis has a clearer avenue inside against a Ravens front missing important defensive pieces.
